rows.label: QUORUM

rows.label: BRASS FAMILY

rows.label: TOP BRASS

rows.label: SEMINARY

rows.label: CLASS

rows.label: SPINNEY
rows.clue: A copse that shelters game

rows.label: LINE PERSONNEL
rows.clue: Personnel having direct job performance responsibilities

rows.label: COVERT
rows.clue: A flock of coots

rows.label: RETINUE
rows.clue: The group following and attending to some important person

rows.label: WORLD COUNCIL
rows.clue: A council with representatives from different nations

rows.label: SUBFAMILY
rows.clue: (biology) a taxonomic category below a family

rows.label: ODDS AND ENDS
rows.clue: A motley assortment of things

rows.label: FAMILY
rows.clue: A social unit living together

rows.label: FAMILY COURT

rows.label: PLAY GROUP

rows.label: SUZERAIN

rows.label: FILM INDUSTRY

rows.label: VIEWERS
rows.clue: The audience reached by television

rows.label: OPERA COMPANY
rows.clue: A company that produces operas

rows.label: ELECTRON SHELL
rows.clue: A grouping of electrons surrounding the nucleus of an atom

rows.label: REVOLVING DOOR

rows.label: CONVENTION
rows.clue: A large formal assembly

rows.label: GENETIC CODE

rows.label: WORKING CLASS

rows.clue: A large dance or jazz band usually featuring improvised solos by lead musicians
